scope: The ten previously registered Viking marine shots are external to the Poland model fit. The survey has been used for other methods in this project.
model: Frozen Poland component 0 from field_recovery_v2. No refitting or amplitude calibration.
window_rule: Match the physical times of the fixed 2 ms Poland windows on the 4 ms Viking records.
effect_rule: Shot mean below zero and coordinate IDW, and at least eight of ten shots better than zero.
